codex.note: Uses the Codex quota of your ChatGPT plan; many bots running 24/7 can use it up. With an API key you pay OpenAI for what you use.

vm.notCreated: The VM has not been created yet
vm.growDescription: It has {{size}} GB today. It can only grow; space on the computer grows with use.
vm.restartWarning: The VM will shut down and start again. What the bots are doing on screen is interrupted.
vm.parallel: Bots working at the same time

vm.createSnapshotDescription: Saves the system state (installed programs, settings) to come back to later. Your files in /workspace are not included.
vm.restoreDescription: Returns the VM system to the saved state. /workspace and your files don't change.

vm.restoreWarningRunning: The VM will shut down, go back to the chosen point and start again.

reset.title: Reset the VM system?
reset.body: The machine goes back to its original state. Bots, conversations, memory and /workspace stay intact.
reset.backupHint: Important data in Docker volumes? Export it first (e.g. pg_dump into /workspace).

update.title: Update the VM system?
update.body: Milibot prepares the new version while the machine keeps running (about 10 min, needs internet). At the end the VM stops for about a minute, swaps the system and starts again.
update.bodyStopped: Milibot prepares the new version (about 10 min, needs internet) and swaps the VM system; the VM stays off.

update.asap: As soon as the new version is ready
update.failed: Could not prepare the new system version: {{error}}
update.waitingIdle: The new version is ready. The system is swapped as soon as the bots finish what they are doing.
update.waitingTask: The new version is ready. The system is swapped as soon as the operation in progress finishes.

github.synced_one: set up in the VM for {{count}} user at {{time}}
github.synced_other: set up in the VM for {{count}} users at {{time}}
github.syncFailed: could not set it up in the VM
github.resync: Set up again in the VM

github.commitNameHint: Each bot signs with its own name ({bot})
github.draftPrsHint: You review before marking them ready
github.autoMergePrsHint: Off, bots open the PR and you merge it. A plan can allow merging when you approve it.
github.checkFailed: Could not check this token with GitHub.

webSearch.title: Web search
webSearch.offHint: Bots search the web in their browser, which is slower and uses more tokens. With a key they get a quick search tool.
webSearch.howTo: Both services have a free plan with a monthly quota. Create an API key and paste it here.
webSearch.checkFailed: Could not check this key with the service.
webSearch.privacy: The bots' searches go from this computer to the service you choose. Pages the bots open do not go through it.

secrets.title: Passwords and variables
secrets.note: Values stay in the Mac's Keychain. Variables reach the bots as environment variables; the others they only use by reference, without seeing the value. Bots can also ask for a password in the chat — the ones you send with “Remember” show up here.
secrets.kindRefHint: Bots use it by reference, without seeing the value
secrets.exposeAsEnvOff: Off: bots only use it by reference — they type the password in the browser or on the screen and read the file in the machine, without seeing the value.
secrets.exposeAsEnvOn: On: besides the use by reference, the value reaches the bots' terminals as an environment variable.

ssh.title: SSH
ssh.hint: add it to servers the bots should reach
ssh.vmOff: Start the VM to see (and create) the key

costs.subtitle: How much the bots of this workspace are spending
costs.nothingYet: No spending in the last 30 days.
costs.warnHint: Warning in {{name}}'s chat, once a day
costs.pause: Pause every bot when it reaches
costs.pauseHint: They resume the next day or when you let them
costs.pausedNotice: The bots are paused: today's spend is already {{value}}. They come back tomorrow.
costs.payloadsHint: Tokens and cost are kept forever

workspaces.subtitle: Separate environments, each with its own VM, bots, memory and keys
workspaces.golden: Base image shared between workspaces: {{size}} (read-only). Each workspace keeps only what changes.

hostWarnings.tcg: VM in TCG (slow): this computer offers no hardware acceleration for the virtual machine, so it runs emulated.
hostWarnings.keyring: Keyring unavailable: passwords and keys are kept in an encrypted file on this computer instead of the system keyring.

reasons.kvm_unavailable: Reason: KVM unavailable (no /dev/kvm, or your user is not in the kvm group).
reasons.whpx_feature_disabled: Reason: Windows Hypervisor Platform is turned off.
reasons.whpx_reboot_pending: Reason: Windows Hypervisor Platform was turned on, but the computer still needs a restart.
reasons.virtualization_disabled: Reason: virtualization (Intel VT-x or AMD-V) is off in the BIOS/UEFI.

hostWarnings.keyringUnreachable: The system keyring didn't answer (it may be locked or not started yet). Passwords and keys saved there stay put but can't be used until it answers: unlock it or sign in to the desktop session.
